name: JCFpmMat
description: Possibly jointed, cohesive frictional material, for use with other JCFpm classes

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: If particles of two different types interact, it will be with friction only (no cohesion).[-]

attributes.name: tensileStrength
attributes.description: Defines the maximum admissible normal force in traction in the matrix (

attributes.name: cohesion
attributes.description: Defines the maximum admissible tangential force in shear, for Fn=0, in the matrix (

attributes.name: residualFrictionAngle
attributes.description: Defines the residual friction angle (when contacts are not cohesive). residualFrictionAngle=frictionAngle if not specified. [rad]

attributes.name: jointNormalStiffness
attributes.description: Defines the normal stiffness on the joint surface. [Pa/m]

attributes.name: jointShearStiffness
attributes.description: Defines the shear stiffness on the joint surface. [Pa/m]

attributes.name: jointTensileStrength
attributes.description: Defines the maximum admissible normal force in traction on the joint surface. [Pa]

attributes.name: jointCohesion
attributes.description: Defines the maximum admissible tangential force in shear, for Fn=0, on the joint surface. [Pa]

attributes.name: jointDilationAngle
attributes.description: Defines the dilatancy of the joint surface (only valid for

attributes.name: jointFrictionAngle
attributes.description: Defines Coulomb friction on the joint surface. [rad]

attributes.name: frictionAngle
attributes.description: Contact friction angle (in radians). Hint : use 'radians(degreesValue)' in python scripts.

attributes.name: young
attributes.description: elastic modulus [Pa]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: poisson
attributes.description: Poisson's ratio or the ratio between shear and normal stiffness [-]. It has different meanings depending on the Ip functor.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Numeric id of this material; is non-negative only if this Material is shared (i.e. in O.materials), -1 otherwise. This value is set automatically when the material is inserted to the simulation via O.materials.append. (This id was necessary since before boost::serialization was used, shared pointers were not tracked properly; it might disappear in the future)

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual identifier for this material; can be used for shared materials lookup in MaterialContainer.

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.
